The type-safe window expressions API and query builder `.window()` support have been implemented and committed to a new branch (`feat/window-expressions`).

### Summary of Changes

1. **Window Function Helpers & WindowBuilder**:
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L137), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L141), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L145), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L149), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L157), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L161).
   - **Offset helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L167), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L201), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L235), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L245), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L255).
   - **Aggregate helpers**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L269), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L275), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L281), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L293), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L305).
   - Each helper returns a [`WindowBuilder`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L106) instance with an `.over(spec?: WindowSpec | string)` method.

2. **Frame Utility & Boundary Validation**:
   - Constants [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L48), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L49), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L50).
   - Helper functions [`preceding(offset)`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L52) and [`following(offset)`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L59) enforcing non-negative integers.
   - Frame constructors [`rows()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L88) and [`range()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L92) validating boundary ordering (`from` rank <= `to` rank).

3. **Query Builder `.window(name, spec)` Method & Dialects**:
   - Added `.window(name, spec)` to select query builders across `pg-core`, `mysql-core`, `sqlite-core`, `singlestore-core`, and `gel-core`.
   - Updated dialect `buildSelectQuery` implementations to compile defined named windows into a `WINDOW` clause preceding `ORDER BY`.

4. **Exports & Testing**:
   - All helpers, constants, and frame functions are re-exported at the top-level package index in [`src/sql/expressions/index.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/index.ts#L3).
   - Added unit test suite in [`tests/window.test.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-pv5z0ash/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts) covering all ranking, offset, aggregate window functions, boundary validation, `.over()`, `.window()`, and numeric argument parameter-binding guarantees.
All tasks, builds, and tests have completed successfully on the `feat/window-expressions` branch. Feel free to reach out if you need any further modifications!
